paragraphs: Inspect barns before daybreak for overnight problems, provide the first feeding, and remove manure. Isolate and treat sick or weak animals in the morning, then feed aquaculture ponds and check aeration. Record growth data and repair barn equipment after midday. Feed again in the afternoon and watch for estrus or impending births. Clean, disinfect, and prepare for the next day before leaving.
